title: Sort the Jumbled Numbers
description: Sort an array of integers based on their mapped values according to a given digit mapping rule.
pseudocode:
1. Create a list of pairs (mappedValue, originalValue) for each number in nums
2. For each number, calculate mappedValue by replacing each digit using mapping[]
3. Sort the list of pairs based on mappedValue (stable sort)
4. Extract and return the originalValue from the sorted list

steps.note: Sorting based on mapped values: [669, 7, 7]. Stable sort preserves 338 before 38.
Final sorted array returned based on original values.
